title: 构建社会情感人工智能实现多智能体交互模拟
summary: 本文提出面向人机多智能体交互的社会情感AI设计原则与软件架构AGIMUD，整合社会感知推理与情感、多模态人机交互方案及分布式AI处理，使智能体与人类可在MUD动态世界中实时互动。
summary_en: This paper presents design principles and a software architecture, AGIMUD, for socio-affective AI enabling interaction between humans and multiple agents in simulated dynamic worlds. It integrates socially-aware reasoning and emotion, a multimodal human scheme, and distributed AI processing, allowing agents and humans to interact in real time within MUDs.
